Hamlet Editor now speaks the game's languages, and quirks behave like they do in the game.

- **Quirk fix:** quirks are classified from the installed game's own quirk data, base game and DLC. Corvid's Eye is no longer listed as negative, and Resolution can be found again. Search matches a quirk's name or id.
- **Editor language:** buttons, warnings and menus in English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Brazilian Portuguese, Polish, Czech, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Japanese and Korean. By default it follows your system language, then your game's. Switching keeps your unsaved edits.
- **Game text language:** hero classes, quirks, trinkets and buildings use the names from your installed game, in any of the 12 languages the game ships.
- Translations are machine-drafted and reviewed, but not by native speakers. [Report mistakes here.](https://github.com/zendevio/hamlet-editor/issues)
- **New app icon.**
- Only one copy of the editor runs at a time; opening it again brings the running window to the front.
- Clearer warnings: Discard restores the last loaded or saved state, and a dismissed hero can be brought back with Discard until you save.

Requires macOS 11 or later with Safari 16.4 or newer on Mac. On Linux, Chinese, Japanese and Korean need system CJK fonts. These installers are unsigned or ad-hoc signed; see the README for installation instructions. Keep a separate backup of your campaign before editing.
